selection.basis: The completed L13 cap diagnostic shows no matched logical effect from caps 80 to 320, so the next unresolved quantity is sampling/topology uncertainty under the frozen primary decoder rather than iteration-cap choice.
selection.why_forty_clusters: Forty fresh 100-shot trajectories preserve 4000 shots/cell while doubling the number of independently resampled trajectories relative to the previous 20-cluster wave. This is more fluctuation-efficient than increasing shots inside the same number of clusters.
selection.why_common_dense_grid: p=0.39:0.01:0.49 brackets the q=0.85 crossing near 0.414, gives five high-p points around the q=0.90 crossing near 0.483, and repeats the q=0.95 high-p sign test. A common grid preserves complete nested trajectories and prevents q-specific post-selection.
selection.claim_boundary: This is an independent confirmation cohort. It is not pooled with earlier waves, and q=0.925, L15, square, p_c(q), and q_c remain gated until reproducibility plus central-90% topology/sign rules pass.
